name: Depth-Enhanced Maximum Intensity Projection
definition: A volume rendering technique that improves depth perception in MIP by modifying intensity accumulation via depth weighting and applying a sphere-based color mapping to disambiguate the ordering of internal structures, while maintaining MIP's detail visibility and avoiding complex transfer function definition.
summary: Depth-Enhanced Maximum Intensity Projection improves depth perception in volume rendering by weighting intensity accumulation with depth and using sphere-based color mapping to disambiguate internal structure ordering.
